description: Implement the core garage loop: users can add vehicles with a name (and optional make/model/year), see them as a warm card grid on the dashboard, drill into a vehicle detail page with Fuel/Maintenance tabs, and edit the vehicle profile inline — all scoped securely to the authenticated user.

tasks.title: Vehicle aggregate + commands + events
tasks.description: Create the Vehicles vertical slice in the Api using Marten event sourcing. Implement commands and domain events from the Sprint 02 brief: `AddVehicleCommand { commandId, name, make, model, year }` → emits `VehicleAdded`, and `UpdateVehicleCommand { vehicleId, name, make, model, year }` → emits `VehicleUpdated`. Store `userId` on events for ownership scoping. Implement server-side idempotency for `AddVehicleCommand` using `commandId` so duplicate submissions are no-ops.
acceptanceCriteria: AddVehicleCommand persists a new event stream and emits VehicleAdded with userId
Duplicate AddVehicleCommand with the same commandId does not create a second vehicle
UpdateVehicleCommand emits VehicleUpdated and changes are reflected in the read model

tasks.title: GarageSummary + Vehicle read models via projections
tasks.description: Create Marten projections for read models defined in the Sprint 02 contract: `Vehicle` (includes photoUrl/photoThumbnailUrl as null in this sprint) and `GarageSummary { vehicles: Vehicle[] }` sorted by createdAt desc (newest first). Enforce access rules: attempting to access another user’s vehicle must return 404 (not 403) to avoid leaking existence.
acceptanceCriteria: GarageSummary returns vehicles sorted by createdAt desc
Vehicle read model returns expected shape (including null photo fields)
Requests for another user’s vehicleId return 404

tasks.title: HTTP API contract for garage + vehicle detail
tasks.description: Define and implement the HTTP API surface for Sprint 02 (api-developer + backend-builder): endpoints to (1) fetch GarageSummary, (2) add vehicle (accept AddVehicleCommand), (3) fetch a Vehicle by vehicleId for the detail page, and (4) update vehicle (accept UpdateVehicleCommand). Ensure the contract includes error semantics: 401 unauthenticated, 404 for not-found/unauthorized vehicle access, and validation errors for invalid fields.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend can fetch GarageSummary and vehicle detail using the defined endpoints
Add vehicle returns the new vehicleId and frontend navigates to the detail page
Validation errors map to the brief’s messages for name/year constraints

tasks.title: Dashboard garage card grid UI
tasks.description: Implement the dashboard populated state: "Your Garage" heading, "+ Add Vehicle" button, and a responsive card grid (mobile 1-col, tablet 2-col, desktop 3-col). Cards show name, optional make/model/year subtitle, and an initial-letter colored circle placeholder (color derived deterministically from vehicleId). Cards are ordered most-recently-added first. Include skeleton loading and retry-on-error patterns per brief.
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows skeleton cards while loading and does not flash empty state
Vehicle cards are ordered newest-first and show initial-letter placeholder
Clicking a card navigates to the vehicle detail page

tasks.title: Add Vehicle page + validation + success flow
tasks.description: Create the Add Vehicle page as a full page (not modal) with fields and validations from the brief: name required (1–50 trimmed), optional make/model (≤50), optional year (1900–currentYear+1). On save, disable form, show spinner, call AddVehicleCommand endpoint with a client-generated commandId UUID, then navigate to the new vehicle detail page and show toast "[Name] added to your garage!". On failure, show inline error banner.
acceptanceCriteria: Submitting with blank/whitespace-only name shows "Your vehicle needs a name"
Successful save navigates to the new vehicle detail page and shows the toast
Duplicate-clicking submit does not create duplicate vehicles (button disabled + idempotency key)

tasks.title: Vehicle detail header + inline edit + tab scaffold
tasks.description: Implement vehicle detail page: profile header (initial-circle placeholder), name and optional subtitle, inline edit mode (Save/Cancel), and tab bar with "Fuel" and "Maintenance" tabs rendered in this sprint. Both tabs show the specified empty-state copy and disabled CTAs (enabled in later sprints). Ensure vehicle detail loading skeleton, 404 state ("doesn't exist or has been removed" + back link), and retry state are implemented.
acceptanceCriteria: Inline edit saves name/make/model/year and updates the header without navigating away
Fuel and Maintenance tabs render with placeholder empty states and disabled CTAs
Navigating to an unknown vehicleId shows the 404 message with back-to-garage link

tasks.title: Tests: vehicle slice (API) + happy-path UI
tasks.description: Add targeted tests for Sprint 02: backend tests validating add/update, projection sorting, and 404 semantics for cross-user access; plus at least one UI-level automated check (Playwright preferred) that adds a vehicle and verifies the dashboard grid and vehicle detail page render.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests cover VehicleAdded/VehicleUpdated and GarageSummary ordering
Backend test asserts cross-user access returns 404
Automated UI test covers add vehicle → detail navigation
